cases.name: syllabus
cases.src:
# CSC0000 Algorithms — Syllabus **Instructor:** Dr. Example (office: Room 101) · **TA:** A. Student ## Course overview This course introduces the design and analysis of algorithms: *divide and conquer*, _dynamic programming_, greedy methods and ~~linear~~ graph algorithms. Lecture notes are on [the course site](https://example.org/csc0000 "Course site") and https://example.org/forum. ## Weekly schedule | Week | Date | Topic | Reading | Due | |:----:|------|:------|--------:|-----| | 1 | 09-08 | Introduction; `O(n)` notation | CLRS 1–3 | | | 2 | 09-15 | Divide & conquer
Master theorem | CLRS 4 | HW1 | | 3 | 09-22 | Sorting: `a | b` in code, \| escaped | CLRS 6–8 | | **Part II** | | 4 | 09-29 | Dynamic programming | CLRS 15 | HW2 | extra | ## Assessment - Homework (4 × 5%) — 20% - Midterm — 30% - closed book - one A4 cheat sheet - Final — 50% 1. Read the notes 2. Attempt the exercises 1. warm-up 2. challenge 3. Ask on the forum > Late work loses 10% per day. > > Except with a medical note. --- ### 术语 / Terms - **渐进记号** (asymptotic notation) - *主定理* (master theorem)
cases.html:
CSC0000 Algorithms — Syllabus

Instructor: Dr. Example (office: Room 101) · TA: A. Student

Course overview

This course introduces the design and analysis of algorithms: divide and conquer, dynamic programming, greedy methods and linear graph algorithms. Lecture notes are on the course site and https://example.org/forum.

Weekly schedule

WeekDateTopicReadingDue
109-08Introduction; O(n) notationCLRS 1–3
209-15Divide & conquer
Master theorem		CLRS 4HW1
309-22Sorting: a | b in code, | escapedCLRS 6–8
Part II
409-29Dynamic programmingCLRS 15HW2

Assessment

  • Homework (4 × 5%) — 20%
  • Midterm — 30%
    • closed book
    • one A4 cheat sheet
  • Final — 50%
  1. Read the notes
  2. Attempt the exercises
    1. warm-up
    2. challenge
  3. Ask on the forum

Late work loses 10% per day.

Except with a medical note.

术语 / Terms

  • 渐进记号 (asymptotic notation)
  • 主定理 (master theorem)
